name: aiweave
description: AIWeave landing page generator built with native Tantu Design Library components

scripts.audit: npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:bleed && npm run test
scripts.build:client-assets: tsc --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib es2020,dom --noResolve --skipLibCheck --outDir assets src/tantu/lib/capillary-bleed.ts src/tantu/lib/maku-shuttle.ts src/tantu/lib/bleed-bus.ts src/tantu/lib/direction.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:bleed && npm run build && npm run audit:browser
